login.title: Sign in to DLPMS
login.subtitle: Use your phone number or email and password.

register.title: Register as a citizen
register.subtitle: You will use your phone number and password to sign in. Your owner profile is created at the same time.

dashboard.title: Dashboard
dashboard.welcome: Welcome to your DLPMS citizen portal.
dashboard.noParcelsDesc: A land officer will register your parcels; they will appear here.
dashboard.noTransfersDesc: Start a transfer from any parcel you own.
dashboard.bookAppointmentDesc: Need in-person verification? Book a slot with a land officer.

parcels.title: My parcels
parcels.noParcels: No parcels registered to your account
parcels.noParcelsDesc: A land officer must register a parcel listing you as the current owner before it appears here.

parcelDetail.noTaxRecordsDesc: A tax official will calculate your annual tax; it will appear here.

transfers.title: Transfers
transfers.noTransfersDesc: Start a transfer from any parcel you own.

transferCreate.title: Start a transfer
transferCreate.subtitle: Select a parcel you own, enter the buyer's owner profile ID, and set a sale price. The transfer is created in Draft status — submit it from the transfer detail page when you are ready.
transferCreate.noParcels: You do not own any parcels.
transferCreate.buyerHint: The buyer must already have a registered citizen account with an owner profile.

transferDetail.noDocumentsDesc: Upload documents via the Documents page, then attach them here.
transferDetail.selectDocumentHint: Upload documents on the Documents page first.
transferDetail.approvedMsg: This transfer was approved. A new certificate was issued.
transferDetail.taxHoldMsg: This transfer is on hold because of outstanding tax. Pay the due from your parcels and re-submit.
transferDetail.documentsRequestedMsg: A land officer has requested additional documents. Upload them and the review will continue.

appointments.title: Appointments
appointments.noAppointmentsDesc: Book an in-person appointment with a land officer for verification or consultation.
appointments.officerIdHint: The officer's user ID. Ask your land officer for this UUID.

certificates.title: Certificates
certificates.subtitle: Enter a certificate ID to view its details and download the PDF.
certificates.subtitleDesc: You receive a certificate ID when a land officer registers a parcel in your name or when a transfer is approved.
certificates.noCertDesc: Enter a certificate ID above to view and download.

notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.noNotificationsDesc: You will see appointment reminders, transfer updates, and payment confirmations here.

documents.title: Documents
documents.subtitle: Upload supporting documents (ID copies, sale agreements, tax clearance certificates, photos/forms). PDF, PNG, or JPEG up to 10 MB. Files are validated by content inspection, stored privately, and audit-logged.
documents.fileHint: PDF, PNG, or JPEG up to 10 MB.
documents.attachHint: Attach this to a transfer from the transfer detail page.
documents.noUploadsDesc: Upload an ID copy, sale agreement, or supporting form to get started.
documents.blocklistNote: Executable and script content (.exe, .sh, .js, .zip, etc.) is blocked at upload time by extension and content inspection. Magic bytes are checked against the declared MIME type — a PDF header with a .png extension is rejected.

payments.title: Payments
payments.subtitle: Pay outstanding property tax via telebirr (mock). Clearing a tax hold automatically re-advances any held transfers on the parcel.
payments.noParcels: You do not own any parcels.
payments.noOutstanding: No outstanding tax on this parcel.
payments.amountHint: Defaults to the outstanding amount. Overpayments become a credit balance.
payments.replayHint: The mock telebirr provider returned a signed webhook payload. Click below to replay the callback (simulates the citizen completing the payment on their phone).
payments.autoAdvanceBanner: When a tax hold is cleared, any transfers on this parcel that were in TaxHold state automatically re-submit and re-run the tax check (PDF §4.5.1 Table 24). Check your transfers after payment to see the status change.

publicSearch.title: Public land records
publicSearch.subtitle: Search public parcel metadata by parcel number, sub-city, kebele, or location. Owner name, national ID, contact information, tax records, ownership history, and boundary geometry are NOT exposed through this public search per privacy policy.

errors.apiDown: If the API is not running locally, start it with `npm run dev:api` from the project root.
errors.noAccess: You do not have access to this page.
errors.onlyAdmin: Only System Administrators can edit settings.
errors.onlyAdminAudit: Only System Administrators can view audit logs.
errors.onlyAdminUsers: Only System Administrators can manage users.
